title: Affine section quotients of stabilized coherent formal kernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $F,H$ coherent formal modules with a morphism $\alpha:F\to H$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $c\in\mathbf N$, $S:\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ and $j:S\to F$ be a natural transformation. Suppose for all $l\ge m+c$ the image subobject of $\ker(\alpha_l)\to F_m$ equals the image at $m+c$, and for every $m$ there is an isomorphism from $S_m$ to this image whose composite with its inclusion in $F_m$ is $j_m$. For an affine open $U$, put $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$, $R=\widehat A_{I(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $K=I(U)R$. There exist a finite $R$-module $N$, an $R$-submodule $L\subseteq N$, and $A$-linear maps $q_m:L|_A\to\Gamma(U,S_m)$, all surjective, such that $S(b\to a)(U)(q_b(z))=q_a(z)$ for every $a\le b$, and $q_m(z)=0$ if and only if $z\in K^{m+1}N$. No stalk or localization assertion is made.

source.place: Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine description of K prime_m for claim (a), using Lemma 087W; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W

proof.text: Construct finite completed modules and the induced completed-linear map with A-linear compatible projections. Put L=ker(f).
Identify the projected range of L with the stabilized image sections by the affine range theorem.

Each j_m is monic by hS. Evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so its section map t_m is injective. The isomorphism hS identifies the range of t_m with the projected range of L. Compose the restriction of p_m, codomain-restricted to this range, with the inverse of LinearEquiv.ofInjective t_m to define q_m. The range equality proves surjectivity. The projection zero criterion and injectivity of t_m prove the required kernel criterion. Naturality of j and p, followed by cancellation of t_a, proves transition compatibility.

proof_origin.place: Tags 087W and 087X; completed linear projections, Artin--Rees range comparison, and inverse range equivalences

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_affine_section_quotients
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj)
    (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l),
      Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) =
        Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)))
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅
      Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op),
      e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m))
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let A := Γ(X, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (I.ideal U) A
    let K := (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap A R)
    ∃ N : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R N ∧
      ∃ L : Submodule R N,
        ∃ q : ∀ m : ℕ,
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap A R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R L))
            →ₗ[A] Γ(S.obj (op m), U.1),
          (∀ m : ℕ, Function.Surjective (q m)) ∧
          (∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) (z : L),
            (S.map (homOfLE h).op).app U.1 (q b z) = q a z) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (z : L), q m z = 0 ↔
            L.subtype z ∈ K ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R N))
